title: Exclude arbitrary-plane temporal rails on the fixed PR1094 word (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A backward safety reduction closes the arbitrary-plane question left open by Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337's [PR1996](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1996). Claim type: scoped proof with an exhaustive finite obstruction. On the exact historical PR1094 gauge44 word, no binary two-plane injected at one helper-helper gate improves the fixed-template ceiling under least common-frame closure and unchanged internal/terminal interfaces. No new kappa.

```text
43,435 planes × 2,525 seeds = 109,673,375 pairs
  backward criterion: 919,876 legal pairs
  remove 718,317 no-ops: 201,559 changed closures
  exact pricing: 45 profiles, baseline uniquely best
```

The backward intersection lemma applies over every field and to arbitrary injected subspaces. The finite application covers binary planes only. The 44 nonbaseline profiles already have normalized moment strictly above one at 1690054109/10^12, below the baseline root. All induced climb ranks, the eight unchanged centre descents and rank-51 idle mass are included. The source scalar identity is inherited; the predecessor census and native auditor are not replayed.

Only `research/complex-all-plane-rails/` is added. The contribution is produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Cinna Davis's temporal-rail question and contract, PR1094 and the retained gauge44/frame-coalescence lineage, and Douglas Colkitt's exact interval engine. Source notices remain unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: PR1996's coordinate-plane result explicitly left arbitrary planes open.
- After: a written necessary and sufficient backward criterion plus generated exact evidence for the complete arbitrary-plane domain. There are 108,753,499 inadmissible pairs, 919,876 legal pairs and 45 distinct changed-closure profiles. The rejection complement is not presented as a taxonomy of failure causes.
- Complete warning-strict normal and optimized registered replay passed on CPython 3.12.15/macOS arm64. Direct runs took 7.450 and 7.545 seconds respectively. Both printed `PASS_ARBITRARY_PLANE_FRAME_RAIL_CLOSURE pairs=109673375 changed=201559 profiles=45 controls=28720`.
- A separate full-frame forward propagation checks all 45 profile witnesses. Another 28,672 small schedule/plane cases check the backward criterion, with three further rejection controls. Assertions are not proof gates.
- Metadata, source pins, exact committed bytes/source history and official 12-file export/input-integrity checks passed at `e1ec7b370176e14bb6309969968c0ae04c4aa556`.

From the repository root, reproduce with the actual interpreter used locally; substitute an installed CPython 3.12 path on other machines:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B research/complex-all-plane-rails/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/complex-all-plane-rails/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-all-plane-rails
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/complex-all-plane-rails --check-source-history
```

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is a historical finite-word side result under the unchanged PR1996 single-injection/least-closure contract. It does not impose a ceiling on the selected P104 word, changed scalar programs, different boundaries, nonminimal closure, multiple injections or arbitrary finite networks. Historical interval-engine correctness and the source scalar identity are inherited. Full native operator, physical frame delivery, stock, rounding, hosting, compiler, outer and all-size theorem obligations are unrun and unclaimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No selected replay, Lean, Docker or historical suite was run.

## Related open work

- [#4993](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4993) explores joint retiming after carried swaps in a different BIT/native family. This result fixes the historical PR1094 complex word and one plane injection.
- [#6218](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6218) studies compatible P104 decoder label planes. Its word, decoder contract and plane compatibility question differ from the temporal-rail model here.

The final live overlap check found no open PR on this exact arbitrary-plane PR1094 temporal-rail domain. No additional predecessor computations were run for these comparisons.

## Open next questions

1. Apply the backward criterion to one exact current-word event/barrier contract, with a complete signed invoice. The historical ceiling here cannot price that contract.
2. Test two coordinated injections with overlapping future cones, charging every induced climb. No interaction search or general frame-inflation obstruction is supplied here.
